_meta.purpose: Registry of school attendance-boundary (catchment) data sources per Ontario board. Drives scripts/admin/harvest-school-catchments.mjs (Tier A). Each verified source was confirmed 2026-06-15 with a live ArcGIS REST returnCountOnly query over a token-free endpoint. Kept in scripts/admin/ because data/ is regenerated by an external ETL.

statusLegend.verified_open: Queryable ArcGIS FeatureServer/MapServer polygon layer, no token, live count confirmed. Loadable via /query?where=1=1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson.
statusLegend.found_locked: Polygon service exists but requires a token / is hidden from the anonymous directory.
statusLegend.fallback: No openly queryable polygons (address-lookup tool, PDF maps, proprietary API, or non-commercial static file). Use the 2.5 km proximity-circle fallback.
statusLegend.harvestable_keyed: Boundaries exist behind a non-ArcGIS proprietary API that can be harvested per-school but has no open license.

_meta.harvestNotes: Field schemas are heterogeneous per board. panelMode='field' => one service split by panelField values; 'layer' => one layer per panel; 'fixed' => whole service is one panel; 'none' => combined (not panel-split). School names must be fuzzy-joined to data/ontario-schools.json to attach EQAO scores (no shared id).
_meta.programNotes: PANEL and PROGRAM are two independent axes. panel = elementary|secondary|combined. program = regular|french_immersion|extended_french. A board publishes the program axis in one of three shapes, and the registry names which: (1) programField + programValues maps a column value to a canonical program on the SAME layer — an unmapped value (Arts, IB, gifted) is DROPPED, so the map never shows a specialty zone as a home catchment; (2) programLayers[] lists extra layers, each with its own explicit panel + program; (3) deriveProgramZones[] names a column on the REGULAR rows that holds the program school each regular zone feeds (TCDSB) — the harvester groups the regular polygons by that column and emits one dissolved zone per program school. Every emitted feature carries an explicit program; nothing defaults silently.
_meta.licenseWarning: MOST sources carry NO explicit open-data license — merely shared 'public' in a board ArcGIS Online org. Commercial reuse is legally ambiguous; confirm terms/attribution per board. Exceptions: Region of Waterloo = OGL-style; Windsor (GECDSB/WECDSB) Borealis files = CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (NON-COMMERCIAL — excluded).

harvesterMustHandle: Drop rows where geometry is null AND/OR the panel discriminator is null (holding zones).
Use the per-board panelMode mapping — never infer panel from a generic 'Type' field.
Paginate with resultOffset if a count exceeds maxRecordCount (seen as low as 1000).
Request outSR=4326 explicitly — native SRs vary (UTM 26918, WebMercator 3857).

Arts/IB stay unmapped on purpose — they are specialty zones, not home catchments.

The /arcgis/ WebAppBuilder services are token-locked (HTTP 499) — RED HERRING. The live app uses the token-free /appserver/ MapServer (layer 1 elem, 5 sec, 2 FI). Self-hosted ArcGIS Server; field names are qualified (ARCGISADMIN.Bndry_Elem_FI.SCHNAME) — pickName's suffix match handles that. Layer 2 = 'FI Boundaries', 14 elementary FI zones, verified 2026-09-21.
Not split by panel; Option_Prog distinguishes English vs French Immersion. Exactly half the layer is FI (ENG 39 / FI 39, verified 2026-09-21) — keepPrograms:['ENG'] used to discard all 39.

FI/EXFI counts (verified 2026-09-21): elem FI 96, elem EXFI 80, sec FI 32, sec EXFI 51. The counts exceed the school count because HCDSB splits a program zone into several polygons per school; the loader already tolerates many zones per school_id.

Elementary only (FAB = Fixed Attendance Boundaries). Secondary is PDF-only => fallback. TCDSB publishes NO separate FI polygon layer; instead each regular row names its program school in F23_FI_BDR (French Immersion) and N_EF_BDRY (Extended French), so a program zone is the dissolved union of the regular zones that feed it. Verified 2026-09-21: 18 distinct FI schools, 17 Extended French. Example — St Cyril's FI zone is 11 regular zones (57.6 km2), against a 3.2 km2 median regular zone and the 19.6 km2 circle we drew instead.

The old `frenchService` key landed 17 rows under the bogus panel 'french', which no RPC filter could ever match. Verified 2026-09-21: that service is EXTENDED FRENCH, not French Immersion — Panel = 'Elementary - Extended French' (11) + 'Secondary - Extended French' (6). It now carries its real panel and program. DPCDSB publishes no open FI layer (French_Immersion_Under_Review is a proposal, deliberately not harvested).

fallback.notes: NOW HARVESTED via scripts/admin/harvest-tdsb-catchments.mjs (492 official boundaries: 431 elementary + 61 secondary). No ArcGIS — boundaries served as KML from a DNN getBounds endpoint (token-free); schools enumerated from By-School-Name directory pages, folder/id per school from ByMap.aspx?focusonschool=. These ARE TDSB's official boundaries; confirm reuse terms with TDSB. FRENCH IMMERSION IS NOT AVAILABLE on this path — investigated 2026-09-21: getBounds exposes only folder=Elementary and folder=Intermediate, the By-Map page never mentions French Immersion, and the TDSB AGOL org publishes gifted-program boundaries but no FI layer. Toronto public FI needs a separate source (Tier B probing of the French-programs finder). The map must say so rather than draw a circle.

fallback.notes: Harvested by scripts/admin/harvest-spsplus-catchments.mjs. The harvester asked only for programTypeCode=RT, so every French Immersion zone was skipped; verified 2026-09-21 that 70 of the 253 schools list an FI program and that GetSchoolProgramGradeBoundary returns FI geometry (37 KB for Bramalea SS). Other programTypeCode values (ESL, SHSM, Truck, EHS*) are specialty streams, NOT catchments — spsProgramCodes is an allow-list, so they stay out. Proprietary SPS Plus product; no open license — confirm reuse terms with PDSB.
